overall_notes: The paper focuses on improving model self-consistency using Natural Language Inference (NLI) models, applied primarily to question answering (both text-only and visual QA). Evaluation is entirely automated using standard metrics. Extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and metric capitalization. The methodology involves re-ranking candidate answers using factor graphs with constraints from NLI models, but does not involve human evaluation or LLM-as-judge approaches.
